headline: Warnings over raising the border minimum wage at the same pace as the general minimum wage
summary: Acción Ciudadana Frente a la Pobreza proposes a 3.7% increase in the northern border minimum wage for 2027. It argues this would avoid widening the gap with the rest of the country.
why: Minimum wage levels affect labour costs for manufacturers and retailers, especially in Mexico's border export zone.
original_headline: Advierten riesgos por aumentar el salario mínimo fronterizo al mismo ritmo que el general
